mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 61-degree temperatures with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park and a bright Full Moon. The ISS will be passing overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Planning Department wants to remind residents that they do not accept online payments or wire transfers for application fees; all payments must be made by check at the City Administration Building. Additionally, fall leaf collection begins Monday, October 5.
We have a busy schedule with Live Music at Bailey's Run and the Verona Fall Fest today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

In a report regarding notable calls for service, officers noted that on September 5, a 26-year-old man was arrested for operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration and cited for O W I after being stopped for speeding.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but they will open today at 10 AM so you can enjoy today's featured flavor.
